You will establish work assignments to be accomplished by the employees in the program, setting priorities, preparing schedules for work completion, and ensuring the timely performance of satisfactory work efforts.
You will determine responsibilities, evaluate employee performance, recommend appropriate incentives, initiate corrective actions, assure safety practices, and keep employees informed of management and personnel policies.
You will be assigned to the appropriate acquisition life cycle program and will be responsible for providing overall direction and guidance for the program organization, administration and civilian personnel.
You will apply managerial skills and a broad background of knowledge in program/project management.
You will be accountable to the Program Manager for assigned cost, schedule, performance reporting and contract activities, logistics, budget and personnel management for assigned activities in any and or all phases of the acquisition life cycle.
You will assist the Program Manager in forecasting and managing workload for the program office or functional area.
You will advise the Program Manager in designing acquisition strategy and program baseline, and direct acquisition life cycle activities and all efforts associated with the program office or functional area through subordinate managers and teams.
You will provide goals, objectives, program and general guidance for operations consistent with higher level framework/guidance.
You will identify requirements and define scope of projects which comprise the overall acquisition program.
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the NH-03 (GS-13 equivalent) pay band or grade level in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector developing policies or guidance to support Shipbuilding and Conversion (e.g. budgeting, planning, program management, execution, and communications) for the resolution of problems within functional areas of a carrier fleet program.

Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management web site: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.

As a PROGRAM MANAGER (ACQUISITIONS) at the GS-0340-14 some of your typical work assignments may include: Lead the design, development, and continuous enhancement of automated tools, digital platforms, and applications tailored to streamline acquisition, financial management, and program management workflows.

Partner directly with contracting officers, program managers, and financial teams to analyze daily business operations, identify process bottlenecks, and translate operational needs into practical technical solutions.

Design and implement data analytics, reporting dashboards, and key performance metrics to evaluate acquisition effectiveness, track program health, and provide actionable, data-driven insights to senior leadership.

Develop and conduct targeted, desk-side training and user-adoption workshops to empower the acquisition workforce to effectively utilize new digital tools, centralized platforms, and data repositories.

Evaluate the effectiveness of deployed acquisition systems and tools, capturing user feedback and lessons learned to drive iterative enhancements and optimize the agency's overarching acquisition strategy.
You may qualify at the GS-14, if you fulfill the following qualifications: A.

One year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-13 grade level in the Federal service as listed below: Analyzing federal acquisition processes (such as contracting, financial execution, or program management) to identify operational bottlenecks and translate business needs into technical requirements.

Designing or developing centralized data tools, digital platforms, or automated workflows that streamline and enhance acquisition, financial, or program management operations.

Developing data-driven performance metrics, reporting dashboards, or analytical tracking systems to evaluate acquisition effectiveness, monitor program health, and guide strategic leadership decisions.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

The United States Space Force (USSF) at Los Angles AFB, El Segundo, CA is searching for an Acquisition Program Manager to support GPS Gen4 Space (NH-1101-03, GS 12/13 equivalent).

Description: If selected, you will serve as the Chief for GPS Gen4 Space, Gen4 Space Acquisition Strategy lead, and backup program management support for all GPS Gen4 contracts.

You will join a dynamic leadership team in System Delta 831 (SYD 831), providing national security Positioning, Navigation, and Timing services to our nation and allied partners, and working to build the next generation of GPS architecture from the ground up.

This specific role requires strong leadership skills, astute attention to detail, creative problem solving, and a collaborative motivation to achieve mission success across a diverse, geographically separated stakeholder team.

You must be able to work independently, planning, organizing and coordinating programmatic actions across various engineering, financial, legal, security, public affairs and contracting offices, both internal and external to Space Systems Command (SSC), USSF.

Strong communication skills are critical, both oral and written, with a focus on clear, concise and technically accurate dialogue that synchronizes efforts across more than 30 government and contractor organizations.

In addition, the duties of this position require the ability to analyze, negotiate, and resolve complex issues while maintaining good working relationships.

Finally, as part of our government team, you are expected to assist in the training, development, mentorship, and motivation of junior civilian and military program managers as they join the team.

Ideal Candidate: Experience with Government Space acquisitions, with government acquisition program offices, and contracts for military space segments; minimum program management practitioner (level 2) DIAWIA certification; minimum bachelor's degree, preferred master's degree.

Independent execution; Leadership; Briefing/clear, concise communication; Critical Thinking; Organization and Planning; Collaboration; Attention to Detail; Team Building. Key Skills and Abilities: 1.

Comprehensive knowledge of the applicable principles, concepts, policies, and laws; functions, programs, and systems applicable to the duties of logistics contracts and program management and material support; sources, responsibilities, and means for providing assistance and advice to resolve logistics contracts and program management problems; and all aspects of logistics contracts and program management support. 2.

Comprehensive knowledge of government and private industry policies and practices related to business management, industrial management, financial systems, technical concepts, and production practices.

Ability to gather, analyze, and evaluate a variety of program information, such as commercial business practices, market conditions, offer acceptability, contractor acceptability, contractor responsibility and/or performance to determine acquisition strategy and sources. 3.

Knowledge of the missions, roles, functions, organizational structures, and operation of the Department of Defense, and entities that govern, interface with, and/or influence management control of proposed and ongoing service contracts. 4.

Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, clearly, concisely, with technical accuracy and to use computers and a variety of software programs and databases, gather and analyze a variety of program information, make sound judgments concerning program progress, and effectively communicate recommendations orally and in writing to higher organizational management and contractors. 5.

Ability to establish and maintain good relationships with individuals and groups within the office as well as outside the immediate work unit and to be persuasive in representing the best interests of the government when dealing with personnel with highly divergent points of view. 6.

Ability to plan, organize, analyze problems, translate complex information, make appropriate judgments, evaluate options, conduct research, summarize results, make appropriate recommendations, and manage critical aspects of service contract requirements as related to the assigned functional area and meet deadlines.

Ability to compose and edit contract required correspondence, review and analyze directives, develop and brief service contract program related presentations.
The 1101 series does not have an individual occupational requirement that must be met. You can view the experience level requirements here. Please scroll down to the 3rd section titled Administrative and Management Positions.

You will serve as an Environmental expert and will be responsible for leading and managing many aspects of the BRAC Environmental Program.
You will lead and manage the annual gathering of environmental requirements and supporting cost estimates in the NORM (the Normalization of Data) database.
You will provide oversight for the maintenance and operations to the NORM database hosted by NAVFAC's Information Technology Center.
You will provide management oversight for the numerous Knowledge-Based Corporate Reporting System (KBCRS) reports throughout the year to DoD that reflect program costs and milestones.
You will lead environmental programmatic initiatives, tiger teams and technical efforts across the PMO.
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-13 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector performing duties such as: 1) leading coordination and negotiations with federal and state regulatory agencies (e.g., EPA, state environmental departments) on complex programmatic or funding issues; and preparing written products-including briefs, point papers, reports, and correspondence-to present and defend program decisions to senior DoD, DON, or Congressional stakeholders.2) Experience leading environmental program management for a complex federal environmental restoration or compliance program, including developing and validating cost estimates, tracking milestones (such as RIP and RC), and preparing programmatic reporting for senior leadership and Congress 3)Experience analyzing and resolving complex program-level challenges, including reconciling system-to-system financial execution data, addressing budget shortfalls, and developing strategic workarounds to ensure environmental cleanup milestones remain on schedule.4)Experience directing federal environmental financial reporting processes, including POM budget formulation, Environmental Liabilities (EL) reporting, and ensuring data integrity across national-level tracking systems (such as NORM and KBCRS) to meet federal audit-readiness standards.5)Experience interpreting and applying federal environmental laws, regulations, and policies (e.g., CERCLA, RCRA, NEPA, SARA) to guide, evaluate, and report on environmental restoration, compliance, or real property disposal programs at an enterprise level.

As part of Caiz , you’ll be part of a transparent organization that values customer trust and ensures the highest security standards in the crypto space.crypto business developmen Tasks We are seeking a highly capable Project Manager to oversee and coordinate projects across all departments of the company.

Responsibilities: Oversee and coordinate projects across all company departments to ensure alignment with Caiz Blockchain’s mission and strategic objectives. Lead execution of blockchain-related projects, from token ecosystem development to exchange relations, compliance initiatives, and community engagement.

Develop and manage project plans, timelines, and milestones tailored for blockchain product launches and partnerships. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including developers, marketers, compliance officers, and business development managers.

Ensure smooth execution of token launches, exchange listings, liquidity initiatives, and regulatory compliance requirements. Establish project management frameworks, reporting structures, and KPIs to measure success across all functions.

Identify risks unique to crypto markets (volatility, regulatory changes, liquidity challenges) and implement mitigation strategies. Act as the central point of communication between leadership and all departments. Report regularly to senior leadership on progress, performance, and critical issues.

Foster a culture of innovation, transparency, and accountability across the organization. Proven ability to manage multiple, large-scale projects across different departments.

Strong knowledge of blockchain ecosystems, tokenomics, exchange relations, and compliance in the crypto industry. Experience managing cross-functional teams in high-growth, innovative environments. Deep understanding of blockchain technology, crypto markets, and digital assets. Strong project management, planning, and execution skills.

Excellent leadership and cross-team coordination abilities. Strong communication skills for engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Analytical mindset with ability to assess project risks in volatile crypto environments. Financial and resource management expertise with an understanding of token economics.

High adaptability in the rapidly changing blockchain/crypto industry. Level of studies: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, or Technology (MBA or blockchain-specific certifications preferred).

This is a remote position. Our client is a reputable Scandinavian SAP consulting house specializing in designing, implementing, and supporting business-critical SAP solutions across multiple industries. The organization operates in a low-hierarchy, agile environment and promotes a strong culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous learning.

We are currently looking for an experienced Swedish-speaking SAP Project Manager / Test Lead with strong SAP ALM expertise. In this role, you will coordinate and oversee SAP Application Lifecycle Management activities, ensuring effective change governance, release management, and structured testing processes across SAP landscapes.
This position is fully remote, starting ASAP, with an initial allocation of approximately 50% until June, and potential continuation thereafter.

Lead and coordinate SAP ALM / Solution Manager activities, including Change Request Management (ChaRM), transport management, and release coordination.
Plan and manage test cycles, including test strategy, execution tracking, defect management, and reporting.
Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, technical teams, and delivery management.
Ensure adherence to governance, compliance, and quality standards within SAP project delivery.
Support structured rollout and deployment processes across SAP environments.
Provide guidance on best practices related to testing, release management, and SAP lifecycle governance.

Fluent Swedish and English (spoken and written).
Proven experience as SAP Project Manager or Test Lead within SAP environments.
Strong hands-on knowledge of SAP ALM tools, including Solution Manager, ChaRM, Focused Build, or equivalent.
Solid understanding of SAP delivery lifecycle, change management processes, and structured testing methodologies.
Experience working in distributed, international teams.
Strong stakeholder communication and coordination skills.

Founded in 2019, Utorg builds the infrastructure behind stablecoin payments: on/off-ramps, self-custodial wallets, and crypto cards. Over 2 million users across 130+ countries already buy, hold, and spend crypto through our app. On the B2B side, the same rails power 2,100+ platforms, with $2.4B+ moved to date.

We are seeking a Senior Project Manager with a mandatory Fintech background to spearhead the delivery of our Mobile app ecosystem (crypto wallet, card, and investment product line ). This is a role for a hands-on leader who can move seamlessly between a high-level roadmap and a deep-dive technical discussion.
You will lead cross-functional squads, owning the delivery lifecycle from technical discovery to production.
Mission
Transform engineering delivery into a predictable "Black Box."
Ensure an accuracy rate of over 80% in "Plan vs. Fact" and liberate C-level executives from operational micromanagement.
What you'll actually do

Own the Forecast: You are responsible for the realism of our deadlines. You don't just record estimates; you facilitate decomposition and challenge "3-hour" estimates that should be "3 days."
Jira as Source of Truth: Maintain perfect hygiene in project tooling. Ensure blockers are surfaced immediately, and progress is transparent to all stakeholders without manual pings.

Bridge the Gap: Orchestrate the team to translate the CPO's high-level vision into detailed, actionable User Stories with clear Acceptance Criteria.
Gatekeeping: Ensure no task enters a sprint without being "Ready for Development," preventing "dumb product/tech decisions" at the source.
3. Team Dynamics & Facilitation
The Buffer: Act as a constructive bridge between the team members. Resolve friction and ensure technical debates result in actionable plans.
Operational Discipline: Push the team to maintain tracking and documentation standards.

Technical Savvy: A background in QA, Analyst, or Engineering is highly preferred. You must understand APIs, Backend architecture, and CI/CD enough to "smell" unrealistic technical claims.
Assertive Mindset: The ability to say "No" to raw requirements and "No" to half-baked estimates. You are the "Sheriff" of the process.
Pragmatic Agile: Experience adapting frameworks (Scrum/Kanban) to small, fast-moving teams. You care about delivery, not just ceremonies.
Experience: 5+ years in IT Project/Delivery Management in Fintech or regulated environments.
Languages: Professional English and Russian (required).
Key Success Metric (90 Days)
Predictability: The team hits its committed sprint goals with <20% deviation in time estimates.
Autonomy: The C-Level is no longer involved in validating individual technical tasks.
Work fully remote as part of an agile, international team reshaping the future of finance.

The clinical pharmacy specialist (CPS) functions at the highest level of clinical practice, works independently under their scope of practice as defined by the individual medical center to directly care for patients.

A CPS plays a defined role in budgetary execution and serves as a mid-level provider who functions to initiate, modify or discontinue medication therapy and as a consultant for intensive medication therapy management services.

This includes, but is not limited to, the following: designing, implementing, assessing, monitoring and documenting therapeutic plans utilizing the most effective, least toxic and most economical medication treatments; helping achieve positive patient centric outcomes through direct and indirect interactions with patients, providers, and interdisciplinary teams in assigned areas; performing physical assessments; and ordering laboratory and other tests to help determine efficacy and toxicity of medication therapy.

Advanced skill in monitoring and assessing the outcome of drug therapies, including physical assessment and interpretation of laboratory and other diagnostic parameters.

Qui sommes\-nous ?
Alpenda est un acteur de référence de la construction en Suisse romande depuis plus de 100 ans.

Forte de près de 200 collaborateurs, l'entreprise accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets de construction et de rénovation grâce à une approche globale couvrant la conception, la planification, la réalisation et la modernisation des bâtiments, avec une attention particulière portée à la qualité, à l'innovation et à la durabilité.

Filiale suisse du groupe DEMATHIEU BARD, Alpenda poursuit le développement de projets d'envergure. Ce lien renforce les synergies et les expertises des deux entreprises tout en préservant l'identité, la proximité et l'ancrage local qui font la force d'Alpenda.

Vous rejoignez la Direction Exploitation, en charge du pilotage des chantiers de l'ensemble des projets d'Alpenda. Sa mission est de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence en matière de qualité, de sécurité, de respect de l'environnement, ainsi que de maîtrise des délais et des budgets.

Nos équipes spécialisées interviennent sur des projets variés, en construction neuve comme en rénovation, dans les secteurs résidentiel et fonctionnel.

Reconnus pour notre expertise dans la réalisation de projets haut de gamme, nous accordons une importance particulière à l'accompagnement de nos clients, à la transparence de nos échanges et à l'excellence de nos prestations. En tant que Chef de Projet, vous assurez la gestion technique et le bon déroulement du projet.

Vous veillez également à la bonne représentation de l’entreprise et êtes un véritable leader de terrain, reconnu pour votre polyvalence et votre capacité à fédérer les différents intervenants.
Chef de projet H/F

Vous organisez, encadrez et accompagnez les équipes affectées au projet
Vous assurez la planification générale et le pilotage des travaux dans le respect des objectifs fixés.
Vous participez aux séances de projet avec le Maître d’Ouvrage et assurez le suivi des décisions ainsi que de la documentation associée
Vous entretenez et développez les relations avec le Maître d’Ouvrage, les mandataires, les entreprises et les autorités
Vous analysez les appels d’offres, comparez les soumissions et pilotez le processus d’adjudication. Vous accompagnez les équipes dans les négociations avec les entreprises et les partenaires
Vous supervisez l’établissement des contrats, des avenants et des documents contractuels
Vous assurez le suivi financier du projet, notamment la gestion budgétaire, le contrôle des coûts, la validation des situations de paiement et l’établissement du décompte final
Pourquoi pas vous ?
Vous avez obtenu un diplôme d’architecte ETS, HES ou EPF, de dessinateur en bâtiment ou en génie civil, d’ingénieur du bâtiment ou un titre jugé équivalent ?
Vous avez bénéficié d’une formation dans la conduite de travaux ou la gestion de projet ?
Vous justifiez d’au minimum 5 ans d’expérience en tant que Chef de Projet, idéalement au sein d’une Entreprise Totale ou Générale ?
Vous bénéficiez d’une première expérience réussie en Suisse dans une fonction similaire ?
Vous possédez de solides connaissances techniques, financières, de planification et de contrôle qualité acquises au travers de vos expériences ?
Votre capacité à fédérer, coordonner et accompagner les équipes est reconnue ?
Votre expérience en gestion contractuelle, en négociation avec les entreprises et partenaires, ainsi qu’en pilotage des appels d’offres constitue un véritable atout ?
Vous êtes prêt à vous investir dans ce projet situé dans le canton du Valais ?

Project Manager (w/m/d)
Technology. Expertise. People. – Willkommen bei der BUSSLIST Group
Technologie begeistert dich. Teamwork ist für dich selbstverständlich. Du möchtest etwas entwickeln, das weltweit im Einsatz ist? Dann bist du bei der BUSSLIST Group genau richtig.
Die BUSSLIST Group entwickelt Prozessmaschinen und \-anlagen für anspruchsvolle Materialien und komplexe Verfahren – von bewährten Technologien bis an die Grenzen des technisch Machbaren. Mit BUSS, LIST Technology und BBA INNOVA vereinen wir jahrzehntelanges Know\-how und vielfältige Kompetenzen, um industrielle Prozesse weltweit weiterzudenken und neue Lösungen möglich zu machen.
Was uns ausmacht? Die internationale Ausrichtung einer global tätigen Unternehmensgruppe mit Wurzeln \- kombiniert mit der persönlichen Zusammenarbeit, den kurzen Wegen und den Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten eines KMU.
Ganz gleich, ob du bereits Erfahrung mitbringst oder den nächsten Karriereschritt suchst: Bei uns kannst du deine Ideen einbringen, Verantwortung übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterentwickeln.
Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Prozesstechnologie – werde Teil der BUSSLIST Group.
Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für internationale Kundenprojekte – vom Auftrag bis zum Ende der Gewährleistungsphase.
Du hältst Termine, Kosten, Qualität und vertragliche Anforderungen im Blick.
Du bringst Kunden, Engineering, Produktion und Lieferanten zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass aus vielen Schnittstellen ein erfolgreiches Gesamtprojekt wird.
Du begleitest technisch anspruchsvolle Prozessanlagen und bist für unsere Kunden eine zentrale Ansprechperson auf Augenhöhe.
Und hier kommst du ins Spiel
Eine komplexe Prozessanlage entsteht nicht an einem einzigen Schreibtisch. Sie ist das Ergebnis aus Engineering, Prozesstechnik, Konstruktion, Automation, Produktion, externen Partnern – und einem Projektmanagement, das alles zusammenbringt.
Als Project Managerhältst du die Fäden in der Hand. Du übernimmst deine Projekte mit der Auftragserteilung und begleitest sie über die technische Auslegung und Realisierung bis hin zum erfolgreichen Abschluss der Gewährleistungsphase. Dabei behältst du Termine, Kosten, Verträge und Qualität genauso im Blick wie die technischen Anforderungen unserer Kunden.
Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde und unseren internen sowie externen Fachstellen,koordinierst Entscheidungen und sorgst dafür, dass Informationen dort ankommen, wo sie gebraucht werden. So verwandelst du komplexe Anforderungen gemeinsam mit unseren Spezialist:innen in Anlagen, die bei unseren Kunden weltweit erfolgreich im Einsatz sind.
Deine Mission
Gesamtverantwortung für Projekte hinsichtlich Termine, Kosten und vertraglicher Anforderungen
Technische Auslegung und Ausführung unserer Anlagen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Prozesstechnik, Konstruktion, MSR und Produktionslogistik
Planung und Steuerung von Terminen, Kapazitäten und Auftragskalkulationen sowie Erstellung von Pflichtenheften
Beschaffung und technische Abklärung von Fremdkomponenten in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Lieferanten
Zentrale Kommunikations\- und Koordinationsschnittstelle zwischen Kunden sowie allen internen und externen Fachstellen
Regelmässiges Projektcontrolling und Reporting
Technische Beratung und Unterstützung von Vertrieb und Kunden weltweit
Das sind wir
Im Project Management treffen Technik, Organisation und internationale Zusammenarbeit aufeinander. Gemeinsam mit unseren Spezialist:innen sorgen wir dafür, dass aus individuellen Kundenanforderungen erfolgreiche Anlagenprojekte werden.
Dabei arbeiten wir über unterschiedliche Fachbereiche, Standorte und Länder hinweg und begleiten technisch anspruchsvolle Projekte für Kunden weltweit. Kein Projekt ist genau wie das andere – und genau das macht unsere Arbeit spannend.
Bei uns bekommst du den Gestaltungsspielraum und die Verantwortung, deine Projekte aktiv zu steuern, Entscheidungen voranzutreiben und gemeinsam mit einem erfahrenen Netzwerk aus Fachspezialist:innen Lösungen zu entwickeln. Kurze Wege, direkter Austausch und Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe helfen dir dabei, auch bei komplexen Projekten den Überblick zu behalten und gemeinsam ans Ziel zu kommen.

The Aviation Regulatory Project Manager performs multiple, varying, and highly complex assignments under minimal direction from a manager or senior leader.

Serves as a principal technical specialist and project manager for major regulatory, operational, and integration activities involving Unmanned Aircraft Systems, Unmanned Aircraft Traffic Management, and Advanced Air Mobility for ensuring safe and effective integration into the National Airspace System (NAS).

Applies experience and comprehensive technical knowledge of emerging aviation operations, operational practices, and regulatory requirements to conduct both regulatory and operational evaluations to support the safe integration of emerging aviation operations into the NAS.

Conducts regulatory evaluations by interpreting and assessing the applicability of existing regulations, identifying compliance requirements, and determining where emerging operational models or technologies create gaps, conflicts, or misalignments with current regulatory frameworks.

Performs operational evaluations by analyzing procedures, system interactions, workflow impacts, and safety considerations to determine how emerging aviation operations function within the NAS and to identify operational risks or procedural inconsistencies requiring mitigation.

Integrates the results of both regulatory and operational evaluations to develop technical recommendations, support rule-making activities, and inform updates to operational criteria and compliance guidance.

Possesses an understanding of new technologies and methodologies, to solve complex problems and develop improved technical processes or systems. Conducts extensive research and analysis to evaluate how new operational models, technologies, or procedures align with existing regulatory requirements.

Integrates analytical results into project deliverables that support rule-making activities, regulatory evaluations, and updates to operational criteria. Evaluates complex operational scenarios to identify gaps, conflicts, or inconsistencies in regulatory applicability, compliance requirements, or operational procedures.

Performs root-cause analysis of operational or compliance issues involving emerging aviation operations and prepares technical findings that inform regulatory updates or operational mitigations.

Uses project management principles to plan, coordinate, and execute complex regulatory and operational evaluation activities and projects involving emerging aviation operations.

Develops project plans, schedules, and milestones to guide the assessment of operational data, procedures, and system interactions; and identifies safety risks, compliance concerns, and regulatory inconsistencies requiring higher-level analysis.

Ensures that project deliverables, analytical findings, and technical recommendations meet regulatory requirements, adhere to project objectives, and align with the priorities of the major subdivision and broader organizational goals.

Monitors project progress, identifies risks or delays, and implements corrective actions to maintain schedule and quality. Tracks project performance metrics; and prepares comprehensive regulatory analyses, compliance assessments, technical reports, and operational findings as key project outputs.

Consolidates operational, regulatory, and technical information into products that support decision-making and operational integration activities. Defines, organizes, and assigns resources to accomplish large regulatory, operational, and analytical work activities. Allocates resources to accomplish large work activities within established schedules.

Works across organizational boundaries to complete complex evaluations, research activities, and support tasks within established schedules. Provides policy guidance and instruction to others, both internally and externally.

As Biogen ’s Associate Director, Access Management Service Delivery- Cyber Security, you are the Access Management subject matter expert and services leader for all Access Management activities at Biogen . This role is accountable for delivering value to global stakeholders – which includes access services to every application in Biogen .

A peer to this role is the Service Delivery Manager of Identity. This role is a direct report of the Global Leader of Identity and Access Management and is a member of the extended leadership team within the Cybersecurity organization.
As Associate Director, Access Management Service Delivery, you are responsible for establishing access management policies and standards and keeping them current.

You are responsible for the planning and execution of initiatives that improve access management capabilities – both central platforms or efforts supporting independent stakeholder applications.

This role is responsible for the entire service delivery process, from planning and implementing service strategies to monitoring and reporting on service performance. Long-term, the largest lever to improve service delivery is through automation into target applications.

While >95% of access transactions originate through our Biogen Access Management (BAM) platform, less than 25% are fulfilled through automation. In other words, 75% of requests require manual fulfillment by independent application teams.

In the near-term, this role will work with their peer in Identity to automate the onboarding, lifecycle and deprovisioning of all types of privileged accounts. This is done manually today via BAM requests and for security’s sake, deserves to be automated.

A long-term objective for this role is to work with the application owners across Biogen to adopt access automation. This role manages the performance of an integrated team, ensuring that service delivery meets or exceeds stakeholder expectations.

You will serve as the business process owner for access management policy, standards and processes which includes:
Authorization (Permissions): Determining what an authenticated user is allowed to do. Common models include:
RBAC (Role-Based): Access granted based on job functions (e.g., "HR Manager").
ABAC (Attribute-Based): Access based on dynamic factors like location, time of day, or device security posture.
Administration (Lifecycle Management): Managing the full lifespan of a digital identity, from provisioning (creation) and maintenance (role changes) to deprovisioning (deletion when a user leaves). Auditing & Reporting (Accountability): Tracking and recording user activities to maintain a clear audit trail.

Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that-s the kind of work we want to be part of. The OE Manager plays a key role in driving the site's Operational Excellence agenda by partnering with leaders and teams to identify, prioritize and deliver business improvements.

The role is responsible for leading strategic and operational improvement initiatives, influencing stakeholders across the organization and supporting the development of a culture of continuous improvement.

The successful candidate is expected to contribute to and execute the OE strategy, support the deployment and sustainability of Operational Excellence systems and drive initiatives that improve business performance.

Typical efforts include leading cross-functional improvement projects, supporting strategic site initiatives, building organizational capabilities and partnering with stakeholders across the INB network to implement sustainable improvements and share best practices.

Key Responsibilities: Drive Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement initiatives across the INB organization to improve performance, quality and operational effectiveness. Lead cross-functional improvement initiatives and strategic projects from identification through implementation, ensuring sustainable business results.

Partner with stakeholders across Operations, Engineering, Quality and supporting functions to identify, prioritize and implement improvement opportunities. Apply Lean, Six Sigma and Operational Excellence methodologies to address business challenges and improve organizational performance.

Facilitate collaboration across functions and organizational levels to ensure alignment and successful execution of improvement initiatives. Use data and performance metrics to identify opportunities, monitor progress and support fact-based decision-making.

Support the development and implementation of Operational Excellence standards, tools and best practices. Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability and operational excellence across the organization. Share best practices and contribute to the development of Operational Excellence capabilities across the INB network.

Key Requirements: Proven track record of delivering continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives with measurable business impact. Experience leading cross-functional projects and driving implementation in a complex organization. Strong leadership, stakeholder management and influencing skills across all organizational levels.

Experience in Operational Excellence, Manufacturing, Operations, Engineering, Quality, Project Management, or a related field. Strong knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies. Ability to translate strategic objectives into sustainable operational improvements.

Excellent communication, presentation and facilitation skills. Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making capabilities. Self-motivated and results-oriented, with strong organizational and project management skills. Proficiency in business and data analysis tools such as Excel, Power BI, Minitab and MS Project is an advantage.

Every day, Lonza-s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment.

Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?
Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?
Then Pennylane is the right place for you !
Our vision
We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).
We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.
Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

s.h: In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to
s.t:
💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants
💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor .
🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe
🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings
🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!
Why this role exists
Pennylane is one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs, building the financial operating system for SMBs and their accountants. Growth at our pace creates a constant stream of high-stakes, cross-functional initiatives that don't sit neatly inside any one team such as entering new markets, redesigning pricing, launching e-invoicing ahead of regulation.
This role owns those initiatives. You'll work directly with the VP Strategic Initiatives (and, through him, the executive committee) to take our most important initiatives from a blank page to a shipped outcome. It's a rare seat: broad exposure to how a scale-up actually makes its biggest decisions, real ownership from day one, and the kind of scope that builds a strong foundation for an operating role over time.
What you'll own
You'll lead selected priority initiatives end-to-end. For each, that means:
Framing the problem. Turn an ambiguous executive ambition into a structured plan: the hypothesis, the analysis that tests it, the milestones, and the definition of success.
Driving the work. Coordinate the product, commercial, finance, and ops teams needed to deliver. You're the person who makes sure it actually ships, on time and to the bar.
Doing the analysis yourself. Build the models, pull the data, and pressure-test the numbers that decisions rest on. You won't delegate the thinking.
Keeping the ExCo close. Report progress, risks, and recommendations crisply and often. When something is off track, they hear it from you first, with a proposed path forward.
Some initiatives you'll run start to finish. On others you'll be the extra set of hands on whatever matters most that quarter. Both require someone who's comfortable being handed a hard, undefined problem and trusted to figure it out.

5–10 years in top-tier management consulting and/or a VC-backed scale-up, with a track record of owning complex projects to completion in a fast-moving environment.
Exceptional analytical capabilities — you're fluent with data and models, and you use them to sharpen decisions, not decorate them.
Structured thinker and clear communicator who can make a complex trade-off legible to an executive audience in a page or a slide.
Genuinely comfortable with ambiguity: strong judgment, a bias to action, and the maturity to prioritize hard.
Fluent in French and English.
This is a role for a strategic thinker who likes to get their hands dirty. If that's you, we'd love to talk.
Recruitment process
Screening with Orane, Senior Business Recruiter (30 min)
Interview with Eric, VP Strategic Initiatives (1h)
Take-home business case, presented live (1h)
Final interview with a founder (45 min)
What do we do to make your work life easier
🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

s.h: 💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package
s.t:
📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us
🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it
⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness
🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French
💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment
🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone
🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.
If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)
We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

s.h: To thrive at Pennylane, you need
s.t:
-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)
-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment
-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)
-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity
We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.
If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.
Important information for candidates
Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.
Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).
Always verify the sender's email address : our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em"> We will never ask you for payment or financial information
(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately .

The Principal Project Manager is a senior delivery leader within Professional Services, responsible for the rigor, predictability, and outcomes of Cyara ’s implementation and services portfolio.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Professional Services, this is a player-coach role: you will personally own a portfolio of complex, strategic customer engagements while leading and developing a small team of Project Managers supporting customers across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

You will set the standard for how Professional Services plans, governs, reports on, and closes out customer projects — bringing PMO discipline to a global delivery organization.

Portfolio Leadership & Delivery Execution
Own a portfolio of complex, multi-phase, and strategic customer implementations and services engagements from initiation through formal completion and closure.
Lead and coach a small team of Project Managers, setting expectations, reviewing project plans, and holding the team accountable to consistent delivery standards.
Personally manage select high-value or high-complexity accounts, staying close to delivery while building the team’s ability to do the same.
Project Governance & PMO Standards
Establish consistent project-management standards, templates, and methodologies across Professional Services, covering planning, resource forecasting, effort estimation, and change control.
Define governance for complex, multi-phase, recurring, and long-duration programs, including clear criteria for closing individual phases and full projects instead of leaving them administratively open.
Build the risk management, dependency tracking, and executive escalation practices that keep engagements on track and stakeholders informed.
Cross-Functional Partnership & Executive Communication
Partner with Professional Services leadership, consultants, technical resources, Sales, and Customer Success to align delivery plans with customer commitments and business priorities.
Serve as the executive point of contact for project status, risk, and escalation on strategic accounts, communicating directly with customer sponsors and internal leadership.
Build feedback checkpoints at meaningful delivery milestones so customer satisfaction is measured throughout an engagement, not only at its conclusion.
Reporting, Financial Performance & Continuous Improvement
Own project health, milestone, budget, hours, and utilization reporting, using Rocketlane or a comparable PSA platform to give leadership real-time visibility into the portfolio.
Track forecast accuracy, time-to-value, and financial performance across the portfolio, and correct course when projects drift from plan.
Identify systemic delivery risks from portfolio data, recommend process changes, and build the playbooks, templates, and dashboards that let the PMO function scale.

Delivery Leadership & Project Management Experience
Significant experience managing complex enterprise technology implementations or Professional Services engagements, including multiple concurrent projects or portfolios.
Experience leading and developing Project Managers, with the ability and willingness to personally manage projects while also providing team leadership.
Strong executive customer communication and escalation-management skills, gained working directly with customer sponsors and internal leadership on complex engagements.
PMO & Project Management Discipline
Demonstrated ability to build or mature PMO processes: templates, governance standards, reporting, and delivery methodology.
Strong understanding of PMI-aligned project-management disciplines, including planning, risk, scope, and change management.
Experience managing project financials — budgets, hours, forecasts, and change requests — and resource plans across a portfolio of engagements.
Experience working across global, cross-functional organizations spanning multiple regions and time zones.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in business, information technology, or a related field.

Experience with Rocketlane, Salesforce, or comparable PSA platforms preferred.
SaaS, enterprise software, CX, CCaaS, telecommunications, testing/automation, or related technology experience preferred.
Why This Role
You’ll bring PMO rigor to a global Professional Services organization, shaping how Cyara plans, governs, and closes customer engagements across North America, EMEA, and APAC.
You’ll operate as both a player and a coach — owning strategic accounts directly while building the standards and capability of a growing Project Management team.
You’ll report to the Senior Director, Professional Services, and partner closely with Professional Services leadership, Sales, and Customer Success to improve time-to-value, financial performance, and customer satisfaction across the portfolio.

Provides administrative oversight and clinical consultation to over 50 other interdisciplinary team members for whom the incumbent is not the designated first line rating authority. Assumes responsibility for taking appropriate disciplinary actions for employees with performance problems in a timely and effective manner.

Clinical Responsibilities (45%) Provides psychological assessment and diagnostic services for Veterans with a broad range of psychopathology receiving care within the clinic setting. Provides education to both patients and family members regarding relevant mental health concerns.

Provides comprehensive, evidence-based psychotherapeutic interventions, including individual, family, and group psychotherapy and psychoeducation. Provides consultation to health care providers about assessment findings and treatment plan for patients to ensure that care is coordinated, collaborative, and integrated within the Medical Center.

Develops, implements, and documents the mental health treatment plan for an assigned caseload of patients.

Als Projektleitung Realisation verantwortest du die Umsetzung von vier bis fünf Wohnbauprojekten in der Realisationsphase. Du vertrittst die Interessen der Bauherrschaft gegenüber Totalunternehmen, Planungsbüros, Behörden und weiteren Projektbeteiligten und stellst sicher, dass unsere Projekte Qualität, Kosten und Termine einhalten.

**Deine Aufgaben:**
* **Bauherrenvertretung:** Du vertrittst die Interessen der Bauherrschaft gegenüber Totalunternehmen, Planungsbüros, Behörden und weiteren Anspruchsgruppen.
* **Projektsteuerung:** Du führst und koordinierst mehrere Projekte in der Realisationsphase und stellst die Einhaltung von Kosten, Qualität und Terminen sicher.
* **Qualitätssicherung:** Du überprüfst Planungen, Ausführungen und Materialien und sorgst für die Einhaltung der definierten Qualitätsstandards.

e/ Participer aux réceptions des installations et au suivi des réserves.
### Votre profil ###

a/ Bonne maîtrise d-**AutoCAD 2D**.
